(a) The municipality of Washington, D. C., itself;
(b) All points within a line drawn 15 miles beyond the municipal limits of Washington, D. C.
(c) Those points in Fairfax County, Va., which are not within the area described in paragraph (b) of this section, and Dulles International Airport;
(d) All of any municipality any part of which is within the limits of the combined areas defined in (b) and (c) above, and
(e) All of any municipality wholly surrounded, or so surrounded except for a water boundary, by the municipality of Washington, D. C., or by any other municipality included under the terms of (d) above.
1048.11 Twin Cities
For the purpose of determining commercial zones, utilizing the general population-mileage formula as set forth in $1048.101, each of the following combinations of cities shall be considered as a single municipality (a) having a population equal to the sum of their combined populations, and (b) having boundaries comprised of their combined corporate limits, with the common portion thereof disregarded:
(1) Bluefield, Va.-W. Va.
(2) Bristol, Va.-Tenn.
(3) Davenport, Iowa, and Rock Island and Moline, Ill.
(4) Delmar, Del.-Md.
(5) Harrison, Ohio-West Harrison, Ind.(6) Junction City, Ark.-La.
